title: NASA GeneLab Data Processing AmpliconSeq pipeline parameters
description: Amplicon Illumina workflow for pipeline document GL-DPPD-7104-D

input_output_options.title: Input/Output Options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output files. Provide either a GeneLab/OSD accession number or a local input CSV file — one of the two is required. If both are supplied, --accession takes precedence and --input_file is ignored.

target_region.description: The amplicon target region to be analyzed.

accession.description: Input OSD or GLDS identifier as 'OSD-#' or 'GLDS-#' if processing an OSDR dataset.

input_file.description: Path to a 4-column (single-end) or 5-column (paired-end) input CSV file with columns: sample_id, forward, [reverse,] paired, groups. Required if a GLDS or OSD accession number is not provided. --F_primer and --R_primer must be supplied when using this parameter. See SE_file.csv and PE_file.csv for examples.

isa_archive.description: Path to the ISA.zip for an OSDR dataset. '--accession' must also be used.

specify_runsheet.description: Path to a specific runsheet when multiple runsheets match the same target region. '--accession' must also be used, and the specified runsheet must match the target region defined by --target_region.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. Absolute paths are required when running on cloud infrastructure.

assay_suffix.description: A string appended to output file names to label the assay type.

output_prefix.description: A unique prefix for output file names. An underscore ('_') is automatically appended if the value is non-empty and does not already end with '_' or '-'. Leave empty (default) for no prefix.

database_store_path.description: Directory where DECIPHER reference databases will be downloaded and stored.

trimming_options.title: Trimming Options
trimming_options.description: Control primer detection and trimming with cutadapt. When --trim_primers is true, forward and reverse primer sequences must be supplied via --F_primer and --R_primer (unless using --accession, in which case primers are read from the GeneLab runsheet automatically).

trim_primers.description: Set to true to trim primer sequences from reads using cutadapt before DADA2 processing. If false, raw staged reads are passed directly to DADA2 without primer removal

F_primer.description: Forward primer sequence e.g. AGAGTTTGATCCTGGCTCAG. Required when --trim_primers is true and --input_file is used. Automatically sourced from the GeneLab runsheet when --accession is supplied.
F_primer.errorMessage: Forward primer sequence must contain letters only (no spaces, numbers, or special characters)

R_primer.description: Reverse primer sequence e.g. CTGCCTCCCGTAGGAGT. Required when --trim_primers is true and --input_file is used. Automatically sourced from the GeneLab runsheet when --accession is supplied.
R_primer.errorMessage: Reverse primer sequence must contain letters only (no spaces, numbers, or special characters)

min_cutadapt_len.description: Minimum read length (in bases) to retain after primer and quality trimming with cutadapt. Reads shorter than this value are discarded.

primers_linked.description: Set to true if the forward and reverse primers are linked, meaning both primer sequences are expected to be present on the same read (typical for short amplicons). See https://cutadapt.readthedocs.io/en/stable/recipes.html#trimming-amplicon-primers-from-paired-end-reads.

anchored_primers.description: Set to true if primers are anchored, i.e. expected to appear at a fixed position at the start of reads. Anchoring improves specificity of primer detection. See https://cutadapt.readthedocs.io/en/stable/recipes.html#trimming-amplicon-primers-from-paired-end-reads.

discard_untrimmed.description: Set to true to discard reads in which no primer was detected. Set to false to retain untrimmed reads, for example when sequencing quality is low and some reads may lack detectable primers.

filtering_options.title: Filtering Options
filtering_options.description: Parameters passed to the DADA2 filterAndTrim() function, which performs quality filtering and optional truncation of reads before error modelling and ASV inference.

left_trunc.description: Truncate forward reads to this length in bases during DADA2 filterAndTrim(). All bases beyond this position are removed.

right_trunc.description: Truncate reverse reads to this length in bases during DADA2 filterAndTrim(). All bases beyond this position are removed.

left_maxEE.description: Maximum number of expected errors allowed in forward reads during DADA2 filterAndTrim().

right_maxEE.description: Maximum number of expected errors allowed in reverse reads during DADA2 filterAndTrim().

concatenate_reads_only.description: Set to TRUE to concatenate forward and reverse reads instead of attempting to merge overlapping pairs in DADA2. Intended for amplicons that are too long to produce an overlapping region, such as 18S fragments captured with 515-926 primers. Note that 16S and 18S should have been separated already prior to running this workflow. This should likely be left as FALSE for any option other than 18S above.

taxonomy_and_differential_abundance_opti.title: Taxonomy and Differential Abundance Options
taxonomy_and_differential_abundance_opti.description: Parameters controlling diversity analysis (alpha and beta diversity), taxonomy plotting, and differential abundance testing.

rarefaction_depth.description: Rarefaction depth (minimum read count) used for alpha and beta diversity analyses. Samples with fewer reads than this value are excluded from rarefaction-based diversity metrics.

samples_column.description: Name of the column in the input CSV file (or GeneLab runsheet) that contains unique sample identifiers. When using --accession, this is set automatically to 'Sample Name'.

group.description: Name of the column in the input CSV file that contains treatment group labels. This column is used to define contrasts for diversity analysis and differential abundance testing. When using --accession, this is set automatically to 'groups'.

remove_struc_zeros.description: Set to true to remove structural zeros (a.k.a ASVs with zero counts in all samples of at least one treatment group)

remove_rare.description: Set to true to filter out rare taxa and low-depth samples before diversity and differential abundance analysis. When enabled, the thresholds defined by --prevalence_cutoff and --library_cutoff are applied.

prevalence_cutoff.description: Applies when --remove_rare is true. A decimal fraction between 0 and 1 representing the minimum proportion of samples in which a taxon must be present to be retained. For example, 0.15 retains only taxa present in at least 15% of samples. Default is 0 (no prevalence filtering).

library_cutoff.description: Applies when --remove_rare is true. Samples with total read counts (library sizes) below this threshold are excluded from diversity and differential abundance analysis. For example, set to 100 to discard samples with fewer than 100 reads. Default is 0 (no library size filtering).

diff_abund_method.description: Differential abundance method(s) to run. 'ancombc1' runs ANCOMBC v1; 'ancombc2' runs ANCOMBC v2; 'deseq2' runs DESeq2; 'all' (default) runs all three methods sequentially.

debugging_options.title: Debugging options
debugging_options.description: Parameters used to reduce the size of inputs or reference data

limit_samples_to.description: Only use the first n samples for the analysis

force_single_end.description: Force single-end mode by specifying which read to use

general_pipeline_settings.title: General Pipeline Settings
general_pipeline_settings.description: General settings controlling pipeline execution behaviour and tool configuration. Includes how Nextflow handles process failures and publishes output files, the container engine in use, and MultiQC report customization. These settings do not affect the scientific results of the pipeline.

publish_dir_mode.description: Nextflow publishDir mode controlling how output files are written to the output directory. 'link' (default) creates hard links; 'copy' duplicates files; 'symlink' creates symbolic links. See https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir for all options.

multiqc_config.description: Path to a custom MultiQC configuration file. Applied to both the raw-read and filtered-read MultiQC reports. Defaults to the config/multiqc.config file bundled with the pipeline.

errorStrategy.description: Nextflow error strategy applied when a process fails. See https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#errorstrategy.

containerEngine.description: The container engine used to run pipeline processes. Set automatically by the -profile flag: 'singularity' when using the singularity profile, 'docker' when using the docker profile. Do not set this manually unless overriding profile defaults.

debug.description: Set to true to print a summary of all resolved parameter values to the terminal at pipeline startup.

conda_related_params.title: Conda-related Params
conda_related_params.description: Paths to pre-existing conda or mamba environments for each pipeline step. Used when running with the conda or mamba profile (-profile conda or -profile mamba). If a path is not provided for a given tool, Nextflow will create a new environment from the corresponding YAML file in envs/. Supplying existing environments avoids repeated environment creation and speeds up pipeline startup.

use_conda.description: Set to true to use conda environments instead of containers for all pipeline processes. Set automatically when using the conda or mamba profile. Do not set manually.

conda_dp_tools.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing dp_tools.

conda_fastqc.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing fastqc.

conda_multiqc.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing multiqc

conda_cutadapt.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing cutadapt.

conda_R.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing R with the DADA2, DECIPHER, and biomformat packages installed.

conda_diversity.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing R packages required for diversity analysis and differential abundance testing (ANCOMBC and DESeq2).

conda_zip.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing zip.

conda_wget.description: Path to an existing conda environment containing wget.
